title: YouTube License Metadata with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required video_id input. Start performs one YouTube License Metadata request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Trainability permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: An 11-character YouTube video ID, not a full URL.
